purpose: Audit the complete frozen execution contract before S6-E0 red-contract preparation so that budget, endpoint, method identity and machine provenance cannot silently diverge.

bound_frozen_plan.preservation_rule: The original frozen snapshot is immutable historical evidence. Every resolution must be additive, versioned, hash-bound and separately frozen before confirmatory use.

supersedes_for_decision_completeness.reason: The earlier audit found two scientific conflicts. The full audit additionally found a method-identity conflict and post-freeze machine-provenance drift, so one consolidated author gate is safer than sequential partial gates.

plan_lint.warning: The linter detects a three-row multiplicity family and does not itself verify the frozen Holm strategy or statistical power.

target_chain.boundary: Structural PASS does not resolve conflicting endpoint definitions or update historical authorization fields.

failure_tree.boundary: Structural PASS confirms branch completeness, not cross-artifact semantic consistency.

research_package_final.interpretation: The manifest still records its pre-freeze preparation state even though later hash-bound freeze and implementation authorizations exist. This is a machine-provenance gap, not evidence that an optimizer may run.

critical_scientific_conflicts.required_resolution: Author selects one budget before any S6-E0 config, run ID, checkpoint or red contract is prepared.

critical_scientific_conflicts.fact: Primary H1 graph-recovery timing and aggregation
critical_scientific_conflicts.majority_value: NMI at 25/50/75/100 percent fixed-budget checkpoints with problem-level median; inactive checkpoints equal zero
critical_scientific_conflicts.conflicting_value: NMI at first valid activation and time-weighted median over later valid graphs
critical_scientific_conflicts.impact: The same immutable runs can produce different H1 values and success/failure/inconclusive branches under the two definitions.
critical_scientific_conflicts.required_resolution: Author selects one endpoint before checkpoint fields, analysis code or red contracts are prepared.

critical_scientific_conflicts.impact: The conflict changes the declared method identity used in manuscript first use, code metadata, search/deduplication and cross-material consistency checks.
critical_scientific_conflicts.required_resolution: Author selects the canonical full name; the abbreviation CVGR-SHADE alone is insufficient to resolve the conflict.

post_freeze_machine_provenance_findings.finding: Three active consistency files no longer match the accepted freeze manifest.
post_freeze_machine_provenance_findings.observed_change_scope: The active copies were updated from pre-freeze status wording to post-freeze status wording, but the update was not represented as a separately frozen versioned binding.
post_freeze_machine_provenance_findings.required_resolution: Preserve both the immutable snapshot and current bytes; create an additive versioned runtime authority manifest instead of treating either active path as silently canonical.

post_freeze_machine_provenance_findings.finding: Machine-readable plan artifacts retain their preparation-time states: target_chain plan_state=PROPOSED with an old preparation authorization and blank plan_sha256; failure_tree plan_state=DRAFT with a blank plan_sha256; plan_package handoff.user_authorized=false.
post_freeze_machine_provenance_findings.later_authority: governance/freeze_acceptance_I3_CVGR_v0.1.json and later hash-bound implementation acceptances are authoritative later events, but no additive machine binding resolves them for downstream consumers.
post_freeze_machine_provenance_findings.observed_gate_effect: research_package_gate --final exits 1 for missing handoff authorization/date.
post_freeze_machine_provenance_findings.required_resolution: Create a post-freeze provenance binding that points to the accepted plan and subsequent implementation authorizations without editing the historical frozen artifacts or expanding execution authority.

verified_consistent_contracts: The synthetic task family has 12 instances and sum(D)=126.
The fixture records exactly 30 ordered common-random-number seeds.
The mechanism matrix has seven registered variants: CVGR, PARENT, DEG_REWIRE, DIV_MATCH, LABEL_PERM, SCALAR_CV and NO_STABILITY.
At 2,000D, 12 tasks x 7 variants x 30 seeds x sum(D)=126 yields exactly 52,920,000 M FFE.
C1 and F arithmetic matches 190,800,000 and 26,400,000 FFE; optional C2 is 143,100,000 FFE.
CEC2006 inventory contains 24 problems partitioned into 16 m>=3 eligible and 8 m<3 fallback problems.
H2, H3 and H4 definitions, thresholds and branch actions are materially aligned across plan, preregistration, matrix, target chain and failure tree.
The 46 frozen deterministic contract tests and static import checks remain implementation-contract evidence only; they do not create performance evidence or formal FFE.

nonconflicting_future_completion_gates.requirement: Bind the exact parent FR-SHADE source/version/hash/license and conformance traces before evaluator-bearing implementation or fair comparison.

The frozen C1 compares the candidate with its parent and mechanism controls, not contemporary external constrained optimizers. A full SCI performance claim will require a separately audited external-baseline/modern-benchmark phase or a deliberately narrower mechanism-paper claim.
CEC2020-M4 redistribution permission and full-paper representativeness remain unresolved; benchmark transfer is not physical validation.

required_route: Use one consolidated hash-bound author decision for M budget, H1 endpoint, canonical full name and additive post-freeze provenance binding.
If authorized, prepare an additive amendment package and deviation entry; do not edit the original frozen snapshot or auto-freeze the amendment.
After the amendment is separately frozen and independently restored, issue a new S6-E0 red-phase authorization candidate bound to the resolved runtime authority manifest.
Keep optimizer/evaluator execution, formal run packages and formal FFE prohibited until a later budget-specific authorization.
